snippet.title: Just A Dice Game - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist Now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4267480/Just_A_Dice_Game/

Just a Dice Game is a relaxing dice rolling roguelike set to an original chillhop soundtrack. Roll physically simulated dice and try to break the game by collecting overpowered relics and other upgrades.
